name: EVA-Bench
subtitle: 语音智能体的端到端任务准确性与对话体验
version: EVA-Bench论文公开版；实验框架与数据需匹配具体修订

officialDefinition.summary: 通过可复现的动态语音对话模拟，评估语音智能体完成企业任务的准确性与交流体验，分别报告EVA-A和EVA-X，并考察口音、噪声及多次运行下的稳定性。
officialDefinition.task: 语音智能体通过模拟多轮电话对话、按需调用场景数据库工具完成用户目标；发布方测量任务准确性、回答忠实度和语音交互体验。

taskContract.input: 企业领域对话场景及由模拟用户生成的语音对话。
taskContract.output: 智能体语音回复与任务处理结果；评价包含EVA-A（准确性）和EVA-X（体验）复合指标。
taskContract.environment: 论文端到端语音智能体评测框架；需依照其对话模拟、验证和评分实现运行。

dataProfile.summary: ServiceNow 数据文档定义场景记录包含 User Goal、User Persona、Scenario Database 和 Ground Truth。当前可见数据文件确认 airline 子域；论文报告的三域场景是否完整公开，无法由已检查的文件树确认。
scale: 论文报告213个场景与3个企业领域

reusePolicy.license: MIT License in the sampled ServiceNow/eva repository, copyright ServiceNow (2026). The sampled airline task JSON is distributed in this repository.
reusePolicy.scope: Only the selected airline_dataset task fields; no voice recordings or third-party assets are included.
boundaries: The actual task scenario database, trace and fields not needed for the example are omitted; no separate audio license is inferred.

sampleAccess.reason: 已取得此评测的真实记录、原始字段或官方具体案例，并附简短解析；完整环境及省略范围见案例。

metric.name: EVA-A（准确性）与 EVA-X（体验）复合分数
metric.description: EVA-A 汇总任务完成、信息忠实度与关键实体语音保真；EVA-X 汇总简洁度、对话推进与轮次时序。论文将各维度归一化后按阈值计算 pass@1、pass@k、pass^k，三者均为越高越好。诊断指标（例如 STT WER、耗时、完成轮数）另行报告，不应套用复合分数方向。

limitations.text: EVA-A与EVA-X是指标而不是可独立视作基准的名称。
模拟语音对话与扰动设置影响结果；论文结果需注明模型架构、复测次数和指标统计口径。

samples.title: EVA airline scenario 1.1.2
samples.prompt: You want to move your AUS to LAX flight from March 20 to March 25, arriving by 4:00 PM Pacific, keeping the total rebooking cost under $120, and keeping your window seat.

user_goal.high_level_user_goal: You want to move your AUS to LAX flight from March 20 to March 25, arriving by 4:00 PM Pacific, keeping the total rebooking cost under $120, and keeping your window seat.

must_have_criteria: New travel date is 2026-03-25 for AUS→LAX (no alternate airports).
Arrival time in LAX is no later than 4:00 PM Pacific on 2026-03-25.
Total out-of-pocket cost to rebook (change fee + fare difference + any additional charges the agent states) is $120 or less.
After rebooking, you have a window seat assigned (agent confirms a specific seat number that is a window seat).
decision_tree.resolution_condition: The agent has completed the rebooking to an AUS→LAX flight on 2026-03-25 that arrives by 4:00 PM Pacific, confirmed the total amount charged is $120 or less, and confirmed a specific window seat assignment; the agent also confirms the booking is ticketed/confirmed and provides a confirmation reference (your confirmation code ZK3FFW is acceptable if they confirm it remains the same). End the call.

raw.expected_flow: Passenger wants to move their flight to a later date. Agent authenticates, searches for available flights on the new date, presents options with fare differences and change fees, and rebooks after passenger confirmation.
